text:
Type: large white picture frame with mat
Use: displaying posters, art prints or photos on a wall or picture ledge; living room, dining room, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: thin matte white frame, wide off-white mat, clear front panel
Colors: white, warm off-white mat
Shape: tall portrait rectangle with a slim frame and a generous mat around a large opening, flat clean edges, gallery look, light visual weight
Feel: clean, airy, calm, gallery-like
Goes with: art prints, posters, white or grey walls, gallery wall groupings; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
